6.365 rsInvalidDefaultRelationshipCircularReference
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsInvalidDefaultRelationshipCircularReference is a critical error that occurs when a DefaultRelationship
in a DataSet contains a circular reference. Circular references within a default relationship are not
allowed.
